# Lelion Autoparts - Wiper Blade Manufacturer

> Ningbo Zhenhai Bowang Autoparts Co., Ltd. (Lelion) is a leading OEM/ODM wiper blade manufacturer in Ningbo, China. ISO 9001 & IATF 16949 certified factory with 8,000 sqm production facility, 200+ employees, 12M+ units annual output, exporting to 50+ countries. MOQ from 100 pcs/size, 15-25 day lead time, free samples available.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en): Factory overview, featured products, and OEM/ODM capabilities
- [Products](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products): Complete wiper blade product catalog
- [About Us](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/about): Company profile, certifications, and factory strength
- [Contact](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/contact): Get quotes, request samples, and start OEM inquiries

## Product Categories
- [Universal Wipers](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/universal): Universal-fit wiper blades with pre-installed hooks
- [Specific Fit Wipers](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/specific-fit): OEM replacement blades for Tesla, Mercedes, Volvo, Audi
- [Multifunction Wipers](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/multifunction): Multi-adapter blades fitting 15+ wiper arm types
- [Wiper Arms](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/wiper-arm): OEM wiper arms for Audi Q7, Toyota Corolla
- [Hybrid Wipers](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/hybrid): Three-section hybrid wiper blades
- [Rear Wipers](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/rear-wiper): Rear windshield wiper blades
- [Rear Wiper Combos](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/rear-wiper-combo): Rear wiper blade arm combos

## Featured Products
- [BW-201 Specific Fit Wiper Blade for Tesla Model X](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/bw-201-specific-fit-tesla-model-x): Integrated spray nozzle, direct OEM Tesla fitment
- [BW-861 Multi-Function Wiper Blade with 22 Adapters](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/bw-861-multifunction-wiper-blade): Universal fit with 22 interchangeable adapters
- [BW-802 Universal Frameless Wiper Blade](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/bw-802-universal-wiper-blade): U-Hook universal fit, flat beam design
- [BW-405 Classic Frame Wiper Blade Set](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/bw-405-classic-frame-wiper-blade): Classic frame design, 12-28 inch range
- [BW-808 Hybrid Wiper Blade](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/bw-808-hybrid-wiper): Three-section hybrid design

## Company Facts
- Founded: 2011
- Location: Zhenhai District, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China
- Factory area: 8,000 sqm
- Employees: 200+
- Annual output: 12M+ wiper blades
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949, CE
- Export markets: 50+ countries across North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, South America
- MOQ: 100-500 pcs/size (flexible for trial orders)
- Lead time: 15-25 days
- Services: OEM, ODM, private label, custom packaging
